summary: Iteration 3 (date range filters + PDF report) tested end-to-end. All 12 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend validated: PDF download works (42761 bytes, %PDF header, application/pdf), Bu Ay preset populates dates, Temizle clears, and DateRangeFilter renders on Dashboard/Expenses/Incomes/Checks/PromissoryNotes with correct testids. Expenses filter triggers reload with start_date query param (200 OK).

issues: Recharts warning: chart width/height -1 during initial render (cosmetic, self-recovers). No user impact.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1085 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, checks, notes, expenses, incomes, reports, notifications).
PDF endpoint fetches all user records then filters in Python via _in_range instead of using Mongo $gte/$lte query — inefficient for large datasets but not a correctness issue.
DateRangeFilter preset buttons 'Son 30 Gün'/'Son 90 Gün' lack data-testid — added ok for reachability but limits testability.
seed_data_creation: Test seeded 2 expenses, 2 incomes, 2 checks, 2 promissory-notes (prefixed TEST_) covering old/recent/future dates; cleaned up via pytest teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 date-range filtering + reportlab PDF export fully verified. Vera font handles Turkish chars correctly. downloadCsv helper reused for PDF via blob works from Dashboard. All 4 list endpoints support start_date/end_date.
